item.text:
**ACCEPT for the two reported blockers and the requested coverage gap.** The invalid-base regression now asserts an omitted track and exactly one `InvalidTrack` diagnostic at the animation name offset ([parse.rs](/Users/megasoft78/Desktop/Freelance/vexel/.worktrees/rust8-svg-animation/rust/crates/vexel-svg-animation/src/parse.rs:192), [animation.rs](/Users/Users/megasoft78/Desktop/Freelance/vexel/.worktrees/rust8-svg-animation/rust/crates/vexel-svg-animation/tests/animation.rs:333)). Duplicate `mpath` resolution counts matching IDs even when a match lacks `d`; its regression asserts the C-matching omitted-track outcome, `UnsupportedPath` kind, and offset ([motion.rs](/Users/megasoft78/Desktop/Freelance/vexel/.worktrees/rust8-svg-animation/rust/crates/vexel-svg-animation/src/motion.rs:232), [animation.rs](/Users/Users/megasoft78/Desktop/Freelance/vexel/.worktrees/rust8-svg-animation/rust/crates/vexel-svg-animation/tests/animation.rs:348)).

The added test checks end timing and inactive state, repeat iteration and samples, additive/accumulate metadata, and evaluator samples matching C. The result artifact explicitly separates these evaluator checks from later renderer composition. Existing assertions remain in place. Repair-v1 artifacts report nine integration tests passing; I did not run checks.
